strengths: Diff confined to the three scoped files (FocusIndicator.tsx, FocusIndicator.test.tsx, AppLayout.tsx)
FocusIndicator gates on loading, focusModeEnabled, and session === null — no always-visible chrome
Exact spec label "Focus active" on an accessible button role; click navigates to /focus only with no api import or lifecycle mutations
Ghost button styling (text-primary-600, hover:bg-primary-100, text-sm) matches existing client patterns (e.g. AddCard, BoardPage)
Tests cover re-entry navigation plus ready/running/paused visibility and null-session, loading, and flag-off absence (7/7 passing)
AppLayout change is minimal: import plus <FocusIndicator /> mounted before PresenceBar in the header cluster
Component is 23 lines — well under refactor thresholds

issues.description: Test suite does not assert that focus API methods are uncalled on click; behavior is guaranteed by implementation (navigate-only, no api import) but the DELIVERABLE must-not is not exercised in tests
